info.description: Open-weight 1.73B text model in the LFM3 family, released on October 27, 2026, for local agents, tool calling, structured outputs, and domain-specific fine-tuning, with a 256K-token context window (input + output). Reasoning is on by default and can be turned off. Liquid does not recommend it for agentic coding or complex multi-step reasoning. Liquid API inference is priced at $0.08 per 1M input tokens, $0.02 per 1M cached input tokens, and $0.20 per 1M output tokens. Weights are released under the LFM Open License v1.0. The pages do not publish a cache-write price, a maximum output, or a request URL.

zh.description: LFM3 系列的 1.73B 开放权重文本模型，2026 年 10 月 27 日发布，面向本地智能体、工具调用、结构化输出和领域微调，上下文窗口 256K tokens（含输入与输出）。默认开启推理，可关闭。Liquid 不建议用于智能体编程或复杂多步推理。Liquid API 推理价格为输入每百万 tokens 0.08 美元、缓存输入 0.02 美元、输出 0.20 美元。权重以 LFM Open License v1.0 发布。页面没有给出缓存写入价、最大输出或请求 URL。

sources.title: Introducing LFM3: Every Modality for Specialized Intelligence | Liquid AI
